BiblicalUsage: Eliphaz turns on Job and asks why his heart carries him away, and what his eyes wink at. The wink is a knowing, mocking glance, the look of a man who thinks he sees through you.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that a look can carry contempt that no words would dare to speak.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
